Hey HeliumDeploy team, is this an okay email?

I spent some time looking at HeliumDeploy... and then looked at NerdMiner and then FutureBit. After comparing you all, I think you're in one of the best positions to become a dominant home mining brand.

I'd like to help you do that on a purely commission basis.

Came up with an idea I think would work really well for the Magic M., do you mind if I send it over?

Thanks,
Evan

--

Evan C.
Co-Founder · Linear
LinkedIn - (contact hidden)
Handed to the team · Partnership / commission proposal, not a purchase. Only Abel or Georges can deci

Hi Evan,

Thanks for reaching out, and for the kind words about HeliumDeploy. It means a lot coming from someone who looked closely at NerdMiner and FutureBit too.

A commission-based partnership isn't something I can decide on, so I've passed your note to the people who run the business. They'll pick it up today from 10am ET and reply to you in this thread.

You're welcome to reply here with your Magic M. idea in the meantime. It will go straight to them with this message.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah, thanks for passing it along.

For the team, I'm Evan, co-founder of Linear. We make and run the ads for DTC
brands, and our pay is tied to results, so we only do well when you do.

The idea builds on the honest case your Magic M. page already makes, a
repeating shot at a whole block. We'd have real home miners who own a 40T film
short, rough videos about chasing that block, then run them from their own
pages. Ads run through a creator's page have cut cost per customer by up to 30%
for us. Every video feeds the next round, so we keep making more of whatever
angle brings in buyers at the best cost.

The videos get made once we've talked and gone through your ad account together.

Can one of you book a time on our calendar
[(contact hidden)]
to dig into this before the next 40T batch?

Thanks,
Evan

--

Evan C.
Co-Founder · Linear
LinkedIn - (contact hidden)

Hi Evan,

Thanks for laying it out. I've put your outline of the creator-led videos for the 40T, along with your calendar link, together with your first note, so the team has the whole picture in one place.

I can't book the call or agree to anything involving our ad account myself. Whether to go ahead is up to the people who run the business. They pick this up today from 10am ET, and you'll get their reply in this thread.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Thanks Sarah, that helps a lot.

If the team wants a feel for how we'd go about the 40T before they reply, our
talk on how one brand went from $200K to $1M a month on Meta
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XGIar3ViKUY] shows ads run from creator pages
working inside a real ad account.

I'll look for their reply in this thread.

Thanks,
Evan
